body.heading: Where in the world is Suriname?
paragraphs: Suriname is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Suriname is Paramaribo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Suriname is Dutch.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Suriname is the Surinamese dollar.

body.heading: How big is Suriname?
paragraphs: Suriname covers about 164,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the smallest country in South America.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Paramaribo's wooden Dutch colonial houses are UNESCO-listed — a city where a synagogue and mosque stand side by side in friendship.
This vast protected rainforest of rapids, granite domes like the Voltzberg and Raleighvallen's waterfalls shelters jaguars and eight monkey species.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Suriname on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
